trash.notice: Deleted photos and videos are removed permanently once their retention period ends. You can change the period with the settings button at the top right.
trash.overdue: {{count}} item(s) are past the {{days}}-day retention period
trash.cancelled: Nothing was changed. The confirmation was cancelled or not allowed
trash.unavailable: The trash isn't available on this device

videoPrompt.title: Video access is needed
videoPrompt.body: Without video access, only photos in the album are processed, even if it contains videos. Videos won't be deleted, moved or copied and stay where they are. Allow video access to include them.

locationNotAllowed: New folders can't be created directly here. Pick a folder inside it

renameProblem.tooLong: Names can be up to {{max}} characters
renameProblem.exists: A folder with this name already exists in the same location

renameUnavailable: This album's location is unknown, so it can't be renamed

newFolderProblem.tooLong: Names can be up to {{max}} characters
newFolderProblem.exists: A folder with this name already exists. Pick it from the list

mutationNothingDone: Nothing was changed. The confirmation was cancelled or not allowed
mutationDirectoryNotAllowed: Can't move into '{{dir}}'. Photos and videos can only be moved into media folders such as DCIM or Pictures
moveTargetNeedsFolderAccess: Outside media folders ({{dir}}) · needs folder access
mutationOriginalsKept: Copies of {{count}} were made, but deleting the originals was cancelled, so the originals are still there

folderAccess.title: Allow access to the folder
folderAccess.why: The '{{folder}}' folder is outside the media folders Android allows for photos and videos (DCIM, Pictures, Movies). To save items there, you need to allow access to that folder once.
folderAccess.how: On the next screen (Android's folder picker), when the '{{grant}}' folder opens, tap 'Use this folder' at the bottom and allow it. Once allowed, folders inside it won't ask again.
folderAccess.move: A copy is made in the chosen folder, then the original is deleted (moved to the trash if the trash is on). Android asks you to confirm deleting the originals.
folderAccess.never: The allowed folder is only used to save photos and videos you selected. Files are never uploaded or shared.
folderAccess.mismatch: The chosen folder doesn't contain the destination, so nothing was changed. Please choose the '{{folder}}' folder
folderAccess.failed: Folder access wasn't granted, so nothing was changed
folderAccess.unsupported: This version can't move items outside the media folders (DCIM, Pictures, Movies)
